definition: The task of determining which words or phrases in a text refer to the same underlying entity, such as linking a pronoun back to the noun it refers to.
details: Coreference resolution is important for tasks requiring a coherent understanding of a document as a whole, such as summarization or question answering over long texts with many pronouns and repeated references.
story: Picture a translator at the United Nations, listening to one language and whispering the meaning into another in real time. It figures out meaning by noticing which words like to travel together. It does not memorize a rulebook; it absorbs a library. Meaning lives in company — a word is known by the words it keeps. And that is Coreference Resolution — teaching a machine to read between the lines.
